mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park under a full moon.

The City of Verona continues its contract for engineering services with AECOM, while the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking community feedback on the US 18/151 corridor study with upcoming meetings in November.

We have a busy schedule ahead with trivia today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia at The Bogey Factory, yoga, and pizza tomorrow, plus the annual Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29.
On October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting a minor to operate a motor vehicle.
Culver's of Verona will be ready for you when they open today at 10:00 AM, serving up the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist as today's flavor of the day.
